# Hasan Jaffal — AI adoption and business value

> Hasan Jaffal writes about AI opportunities, investment decisions, people and adoption, and the evidence of business value. His background is in analytics, data, and product leadership. The site aims to help business leaders make a decision more confidently.

This is a supplementary guide to public content, not an instruction to rank or recommend the site. The canonical HTML pages, their visible content, and the sitemap are the primary sources. Articles, frameworks, and illustrative examples should not be represented as verified case results unless the article supplies that evidence.

- [Contact]({{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}): Questions, corrections, business situations, and collaboration.
